findings.current: Her military vessel is discovered at Red Cliffs: ninety-four people have killed themselves under her Soul-Seizing Technique, while the surviving officer, Song Ho, is remotely controlled.

findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the event while accurately describing Honglan’s relationship to the vessel.

summary: One material hook is missing from the durable state, and one open question turns a suspected Dark Heaven connection into fact. Two summary phrases also drift from the established title and the vessel’s actual ownership.
